research.title: Visual Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking labels, standardizing image dimensions, and organizing training and evaluation splits by acquisition batch.
Implemented a prescribed support vector machine baseline using gradient histograms, then reviewed misclassified images for lighting variation and ambiguous defect boundaries.

research.title: Image Preparation and Baselines for Indoor Scene Recognition
bullets: Checked indoor scene annotations, removed duplicate images, and prepared category inventories to support consistent training and validation partitions.
Implemented a reference classifier using spatial color histograms and logistic regression, documenting confusion between visually similar room categories.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Support
bullets: Processed incoming orders, checked required paperwork, and coordinated fulfillment updates with warehouse staff when items were unavailable.
Maintained inventory records, reconciled delivery receipts against purchase documents, and routed discrepancies to the responsible staff for resolution.

projects.title: Nearest-Neighbor Baseline for Handwritten Digit Recognition
bullets: Implemented a nearest-neighbor classifier for handwritten digit images, applying pixel normalization and selecting neighborhood size using a validation split.
Compared raw pixel and pooled intensity representations, inspected classification errors, and summarized sensitivity to digit alignment and stroke variation.
